summary: If you have been carrying something mostly on your own, this is a good time to let the circle of support get bigger.
body: If you have been carrying something mostly on your own, this is a good time to let the circle of support get bigger. When the Moon sextiles Jupiter, a personal need can connect with more generosity, resources, people, or practical help than you could provide by yourself. Be specific about what would make a difference. Ask for the ride, meal, introduction, money, childcare, extra set of hands, or whatever would actually reduce the burden instead of making people guess how to help.
